all_tweets.author: AnthropicAI
all_tweets.text: Today, we're kicking off the first phase of the research preview for Model Hardware Standard (MHS): a new standard for AI agents to safely operate physical equipment in scientific research and advanced manufacturing.

all_tweets.author: ClementDelangue
all_tweets.text: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT FROM HUGGING FACE TODAY: We're unveiling Microduck. It's a tiny $399 open-source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning. It can walk, pick things up, get back up when it falls, and even roller-skate.

all_tweets.author: kwindla
all_tweets.text: Introducing PhoneLLM, an open model for voice agents. GPT 5.6 Terra performance on typical voice agent tasks at 1/3 the latency and 1/18 the cost. For voice agents, we need models that are both very low latency and very good at tool calling and instruction following.

all_tweets.author: HedgieMarkets
all_tweets.text: Thomson Reuters just built its own AI model for about $40 million over two years. The final training run cost $450,000. They started with Qwen, an open-source model from China's Alibaba, and trained it on their own legal and news content from Westlaw, Practical Law

all_tweets.author: MTSlive
all_tweets.text: SITUATION DETECTED: Sam Altman says that OpenAI plans to build its own humanoid robots, and that their first uses may be to build more robots and then to construct future data centers, per Alex Heath.

all_tweets.author: IlirAliu_
all_tweets.text: The University of Michigan put their entire robotics degree on GitHub. Not one course. The whole curriculum. ROB 101, ROB 311, ROB 501, ROB 530.

all_tweets.author: ni5arga
all_tweets.text: be sarvam, fork @OpenAI's apache-2.0 licensed open source code, strip the attribution, call it sovereign ai. incredible engineering. these are our frontier labs man.

all_tweets.author: firesidealpha
all_tweets.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says he has no interest in destroying the SaaS companies his models are supposedly wiping out. We're not interested in destroying anyone. We think of this as a very positive sum thing.

all_tweets.author: LigengZhu
all_tweets.text: Introducing GLM-5.3-Flash. Leading capabilities at a highly competitive price. Natively multimodal with a 1M-token context window. A 320B-A18B model released under the MIT License. Previously previewed as Ox Alpha, running entirely on Chinese AI chips.

all_tweets.author: NewsTongueX
all_tweets.text: Google, Microsoft propose WebMCP standard to let websites declare AI agent tools. WebMCP, a Community Group draft developed jointly by Google (Chrome) and Microsoft (Edge) in the W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group, replaces screen-scraping with a JavaScript API.
